name: @explorin/marketing
description: Explorin public landing page: static HTML and CSS, brand assets synced from packages/brand.

scripts.sync-brand: rm -rf public/brand && mkdir -p public/brand && cp ../../packages/brand/svg/lockup-horizontal-ink.svg ../../packages/brand/svg/lockup-horizontal-cream.svg ../../packages/brand/svg/favicon.svg ../../packages/brand/svg/pattern-tile.svg ../../packages/brand/svg/mark-orange.svg ../../packages/brand/png/og-card-green-1200.png ../../packages/brand/png/app-icon-green-180.png public/brand/
scripts.dev: npm run sync-brand && python3 -m http.server 4321 --directory public
